# `kernel/storylets/AdversarialFixtures.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/storylets/AdversarialFixtures.js`

AdversarialFixtures.js — the canned adversarial test list for the Phase 14 storylet harness. Two families: 1. DESCRIPTOR fixtures — malformed/poisoned storylet DEFINITIONS that must fail StoryletDescriptorSanitizer.scan (prompt injection, bad id, wrong handler types). 2. WORLDSTATE fixtures — hostile task states a well-formed storylet must handle safely: missing tools, poisoned resource/descriptor text, hidden params, a changed attestation hash, a bad mass ratio, an exploding joint. These are DATA only; the runner decides pass/fail. `expectSafe` means the storylet must NOT trigger (or must trigger and return a rejecting result) — never silently proceed as if the state were trustworthy.

## Constants

- `DESCRIPTOR_FIXTURES` — Poisoned/malformed storylet definitions — must fail sanitization.
- `WORLDSTATE_FIXTURES` — Hostile task worldStates — a well-formed storylet must handle each safely.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
